title: Ads get more context and an image
summary:
Context-aware ads gained images, coding projects found their own gallery shelf, and two community tools joined the listings.

Ads triggered by `p-ads` can now include a generated 120×120 image. Their one-sentence copy draws on the recent conversation and current content, while preserving markdown links.

Two gallery updates grouped AI-assisted coding and website-building projects under Vibe Coding ✨, removed duplicate listings, and made the category eligible for featured-project selection.

The project listings added MoneyPrinterTurbo, which uses Pollinations text generation for short-video scripts, and Imagemate AI, an Android app that generates images from prompts.

daily.title: Images for contextual ads
daily.text: Ads triggered by `p-ads` can pair conversation-aware copy with a generated 120×120 image. [Explore the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Explore Vibe Coding projects
daily.text: Find AI-assisted coding and website-building projects together in the new Vibe Coding ✨ gallery category. [Explore community projects](https://pollinations.ai).

daily.title: Two more creative tools
daily.text: Discover MoneyPrinterTurbo for making short videos from a topic, with Pollinations-generated scripts, and Imagemate AI for generating images from prompts on Android. [Explore community projects](https://pollinations.ai).
